name: COSMOAGENT
title: Agentic Cosmological Simulation on Frontier
question: Can AI agents orchestrate leadership-scale cosmological simulations while scientists remain in control?
goal: Study the Lyman-α forest and signatures of dynamical dark energy by connecting high-resolution simulations with scientific observations.
approach: A scientist supplies an experiment goal in natural language. Planner, execution, debugger, and result-analyzer agents coordinate a Plan → Run → Debug → Analyze loop through a unified toolset connected to Frontier. Results can inform the next experiment, with experts supervising critical decisions.
achievements: Completed an initial agentic cosmological simulation on Frontier.
Demonstrated the workflow at 256³ resolution and scaled to 4096³.
Connected natural-language scientific goals to exascale execution.
Demonstrated failure handling, debugging, and replanning within the simulation workflow.
scope_note: The supplied slides distinguish a 100-megaparsec, 4096³ agentic simulation from a larger 300-megaparsec, 12600³ expert-run simulation. Extending the agentic workflow to larger simulations remains an objective.
support: ASCR · U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science
publication: Das, S., et al. — manuscript in preparation.
poster: AI-Powered Cosmological Simulation for Dark Energy Signatures
